title: SetVertexPositions
description: Writes absolute positions onto the named vertices of an object's managed mesh: the exact undo of a selection motion and the concrete kind of a kernel edit that only repositions vertices. Its hard bounds (a vertex named once, finite positions, Normal channels named once) state the payload-intrinsic breach the diff refuses as `mutation.invariant`; refusals that depend on the base (an absent object, mesh or vertex) belong to the diff alone.

description.en: The object whose mesh receives the positions.
description.de: Das Objekt, dessen Netz die Positionen erhält.

description.en: The vertices and the absolute position each one is written to.
description.de: Die Eckpunkte und die absolute Position, auf die jeder gesetzt wird.

description.en: The absolute content of the Normal attribute channels the same motion rewrote.
description.de: Der absolute Inhalt der Normalen-Attributkanäle, die dieselbe Bewegung umschrieb.
